Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Sent · Just now

Barkers AI Agent · AI

Barkers AI Agent · AI says:

Yes, damaged items are handled differently from standard change-of-mind returns. For a regular return, items must be in their original, unwashed condition with all labels and swing tags attached. Items that have been worn, damaged, washed, or altered cannot be returned for change of mind.

If your item is faulty or damaged, it will be assessed under our faulty-items process. Barkers will review the item and may offer a repair, replacement, refund, exchange, or store credit, following the Consumer Guarantees Act.

If you are unsure whether your item qualifies as faulty, you can bring it to your nearest store or contact Customer Care for assessment.
